import unicodedata

def fix_romanian(text: str) -> str:
    # Normalize to NFC first to have a consistent base
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', text)
    
    # Map incorrect comma-below variants to standard cedilla/comma-below variants as per standard orthography (comma below).
    # Specifically, Ş (S with cedilla) -> Ș (S with comma below)
    # Ţ (T with cedilla) -> Ț (T with comma below)
    # and lowercase variants: ş -> ș, ţ -> ț.
    
    translation_table = str.maketrans({
        '\u015e': '\u0218',  # Ş -> Ș
        '\u015f': '\u0219',  # ş -> ș
        '\u0162': '\u021a',  # Ţ -> Ț
        '\u0163': '\u021b',  # ţ -> ț
    })
    
    return text.translate(translation_table)
